info.name: Proxy a request to a connected third-party API

params.name: integrationType
params.description: The integration type slug (e.g. salesforce, slack, googledrive).

params.name: apiPath
params.description: The third-party provider API path to call (may contain slashes).

items.docs: Forwards a request to the connected user's third-party API for the given integration type (for example, `salesforce` or `slack`) at the given provider path. Paragon injects the user's stored OAuth credentials so your application never handles the third-party token. GET, PUT, PATCH, and DELETE are also supported against the same path. Also reachable at https://proxy.useparagon.com.
